metadata.denominator: All civilian noninstitutional residents aged 22–25 in each state
metadata.numerator: Residents aged 22–25 employed full time in a THAIE Q5 primary occupation
metadata.rate: 100 × sum of weighted Q5 FT employment / sum of weighted age-group population across nine observed months
metadata.suppression: At least 200 population person-month records and 50 Q5 full-time person-month records; both years must pass for changes
metadata.uncertainty: Repeated CPS respondents are included across months. These are descriptive weighted ratios; the display threshold does not ensure precision and no design-based significance is claimed.
